services.name: Equipment Rental
services.desc: Equipment from the InterAccess studio can be rented for off-site use. Items can be rented for personal projects, short exhibitions, workshops and more. At this time, only InterAccess Studio Members are able to rent equipment. A 50% reduced rental rate is available for Annual and Seasonal Studio Members. Rentals are generally limited to one month to ensure equipment is regularly maintained and available. Equipment availability regularly fluctuates based on member needs and internal programming, consider reaching out ahead of your rental to confirm availability.
